# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large batch of raw call snippets, but **only a minority are genuine sales/enquiry calls**. A heavy majority are internal-operations chatter: Porter/driver pickup coordination, "vண்டி number சொல்லுங்க," location/landmark directions to drivers, loading/unloading disputes, payment-follow-up calls to accounts, GPS/location sharing, crane/warehouse coordination, and a few unrelated spam/telemarketing calls (SRM college sponsorship ask, HR/job call, Porter damage-claim complaint calls). These were excluded per instructions.

The genuine sales material that remains shows Crayon Roofing & Structures operating as a **dealer/trader of JSW-brand color-coated roofing sheets and related roofing accessories**, plus a smaller, secondary trade in **polycarbonate sheets, welding rods/electrodes, self-drilling screws, cutting & grinding wheels, and MS pipe**. There is **no Tata Steel roofing sheet stock** (repeatedly declined — "Tata brand available இல்லை Sir, நம்மகிட்ட JSW தான்"), and PVC downpipes are also not stocked ("PVC வராது Ma'am, roofing sheet metal roofing sheet-ல பண்ணலாம்"). Given the volume of real sales dialogue is moderate (~30-40 usable snippets out of 150+), this KB should be read as a **grounded but partial picture** — enough for coaching on tone, rate-quoting discipline, and objection patterns, not an exhaustive price book.

## Products & brand ladder

**Core product: Color-coated GI/GP roofing sheets (profile sheet / plain sheet), JSW base metal**
- **Brand tiers (highest to most economical), as described by the reps themselves:**
  - **Coloron Plus** — "நல்ல branded sir... 15 years warranty வரைக்கும் வரும்." Premium JSW variant.
  - **Silveron Plus / Silver-on Plus** — explained as a step below Coloron Plus; one rep explained the brand evolution: "முதல்ல JSW Steel தான் முதல்ல வரும்... அதுக்கப்புறம்தான் Color-on Plus-ன்னு போட ஆரம்பிச்சாங்க. அதுக்கப்புறம் Silver-on Plus போட ஆரம்பிச்சாங்க." Same AZ150 coating category as Radiance (a competitor brand).
  - **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus** — mid brand, frequently quoted, often out of stock ("Pragathi stock இல்ல, வரணும்").
  - **Indra Dhanush (Asian Dhanush)** — explicitly positioned as the **budget option**: "கம்மி quality and கம்மி thickness-ல வேணும்னு கேட்டீங்கன்னா 0.45 Asian இந்த Dhanush-னு ஒரு brand இருக்கு sir. அது வந்து உங்களுக்கு கொஞ்சம் கம்மி price-ல வரும்."
  - **Radiance** — a **competitor** brand customers bring quotations from for price comparison ("Radiance quotation வாங்கி இருக்காங்க... அதனால கொஞ்சம் competition-ல போகுது").
- **Thicknesses sold:** 0.40, 0.45, 0.47, 0.50 mm.
- **Colors:** Sky Blue, Off White/Half White, Grey, Silver, Nova Blue, Green/Mixed Green (noted as rare/non-standard — "mixed green-ன்றது வந்து rare-ஆ இருக்கும்"), Non-color/plain silver variant.
- **Format:** Sheets sold by running length/number of pieces per standard widths (e.g., "14 அடி-ல 40 சீட்டு," "19 அடியில 38 number"); plain (flat) coil also rolled and supplied in 4ft width rolls for easy transport.

**Accessories:** L Flash, Ridge (standard ridge, with/without "lip"), Crimp sheet (8+2ft = 10ft with crimp fold), Purlins ("Palli"). These are called out as **manual, slow to produce** — "Fully manually ready பண்றது... 100 L flash இருக்கு அது ஃபுல்லாவே manually ready பண்ணணும் sir time ஆகும்ல."

**Polycarbonate sheets** (separate product line, for cabins/partitions/skylights):
- **Solid type** — transparent, "கண்ணாடி மாதிரி," used where true see-through transparency is needed ("இங்க இருந்து அங்க பார்த்தா தெரியுறதுதான் actual transparent").
- **Multi-wall type** — NOT truly see-through despite customer confusion; only lets light through. Available in 6mm only ("Multi wall-னா 6 mm-ல வரும்"); solid comes in 4, 5, 6mm.
- 2mm polycarbonate also quoted at ₹800+GST/sq m.

**Welding & hardware (secondary line, via Tata dealer tie-up):** Tata welding rods/electrodes (2.5mm, sold by carton = 12 packets), self-drilling screws (1", 1.5"), cutting & grinding wheels, MS pipe/CHS pipe enquiry (CHS not available, "இப்ப அந்த மாதிரி இருக்கு Ma'am MS pipe அதுதான் இருக்கு").

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

| Item | Rate quoted | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Coloron Plus 0.47mm | ₹435 + GST / sq m | Most frequently quoted "list" rate; also 405, 410, 415, 420, 425, 430 appear in different negotiation moments — rates clearly fluctuate day to day |
| Coloron Plus (kg basis) | ₹113–₹114 / kg (+tax) | "rate ஏறி இருக்கு" revisions common within the same week |
| Pragathi / Pragathi Plus | ₹380 / ₹385 / ₹395 + GST per sq m; ₹102 /kg | Frequently "stock இல்ல," delivery delay 1–3 days |
| Kalaram Plus | ₹425 + GST / sq m; ₹113/kg | |
| Indra Dhanush (budget) | ₹91–₹98 /kg (40–45kg) | Explicit daily volatility: "இன்னைக்கு 112, நேத்திக்கு 113" |
| Solid polycarbonate 5mm | ₹190 + GST / sq ft (rate formula "38×5") | |
| Multi-wall polycarbonate 6mm | ₹32 + GST / sq ft | |
| 2mm polycarbonate | ₹800 + GST / sq m | |
| Welding rod (2.5mm) | ₹336/packet retail; ₹285+tax base; 12 packets/carton; bulk >10 cartons = discount | |
| Tender/bulk SMP coat sheets | Minimum order 5,000 sq m required before price is released | |

**Terms observed:**
- GST is **always added separately** — reps are careful to say "435 + GST," never an inclusive figure, to avoid confusion.
- Rates are **quoted per square meter by default**; when a customer asks in square feet, the rep must convert and confirm back ("square feet madam? square meter rate தான் கொடுத்துருக்கேன்").
- Rate changes mid-day are common and used as a **closing lever**: "இன்னைக்கு போட்டா மட்டும்தான் பழைய rate. நாளைக்கெல்லாம் புது rate வந்துரும்."
- Accessories (L Flash, Ridge, crimp) are custom/manual work and carry **longer lead times** than standard profile sheet, independent of thickness stock.
- Large bulk sheet orders are generally **delivered rolled (coil-style)** rather than cut sheets when being long-distance transported, to ease logistics.

## Objection Playbook

**1. "Rate ஏறி இருக்கு / rate-அ ஏத்தி சொல்றீங்க" (price increase pushback)**
> "₹550 rate-ஏ கொடுத்துட்டாங்க... நீங்க rate-அ ஏத்தி சொல்றீங்க ஏன் தானி பண்றீங்களோ sir?"
